sections.content: Trust-recovery plan targets Acceptance and Quick Dev at baseline 3c285bcc and plan commit 868328c8. Lifecycle state records implementation authorized, Quick Dev complete, and acceptance passed. The plan requires v3 hash-bound inputs, persisted DAG and registry projections only, fail-closed retry behavior, successor identity reservation before materialization, byte-identical lineage reuse only, one recoverable prior-RED to GREEN transition, full chain validation, freshness through an accepted ADR superseding ADR-0057 while preserving the ADR-0050 LKG gate, and read-only treatment of 2026-08-17 evidence.
sections.title: Requirements Summary

sections.content: migration_bridge.py materializes declared Quick Dev RED tests for R0 through R2 using fixed pytest templates and exits on unknown slices or conflicting existing files. terminal_full.py validates plan authority, knowledge freeze, skill input receipt, command registry entries, candidate bindings, and terminal receipts, then emits a non-authorizing terminal-result JSON for selected slices or the full suite. validate_all.py produces plan-local validator identities and slice candidate hashes using canonical JSON and SHA256 over declared source sets.
sections.title: Tooling Summary

sections.content: All four manifest sources were covered by one complete page each and accepted. Noted ambiguities include unused migration_bridge arguments for plan and snapshots, missing JSON or missing-file guards around contract and registry reads in terminal_full.py, and shared candidate source selection for R0 and R4 in validate_all.py.
